Maduro Pleads Not Guilty to US Torture Conspiracy Charge

Venezuelan President Nicolás Maduro has pleaded not guilty to charges of conspiring to commit torture in the United States. He appeared in court in New York to face the allegations, which stem from his alleged role in a conspiracy to torture political opponents. The charges were brought by the US government.
